readerCopy.body: The relationship pattern you know best may be exactly what is making the current situation harder. Venus square the South Node can expose an old way of keeping affection, peace, money, or approval in place. You may agree too quickly, spend to soothe the discomfort, choose the familiar person, or make yourself easy to accommodate because the strategy once worked. The friction is useful because it shows the price clearly. Being wanted, liked, or comfortable is not enough reason to keep repeating terms you would not choose from scratch.
